identity.name: Spirit Automatic
identity.one_liner: The 42mm Spirit Automatic with the 100m water resistance and the L888.4 caliber — Longines' 2020 dress/sport watch that competes with the Tudor Black Bay at the under-$2,500 price point.

narrative.story: The Spirit Automatic is the 2020 reference that positioned Longines in the entry-luxury dress/sport segment. The 42mm stainless steel case, the 100m water resistance, the bidirectional internal bezel with the twin-flag design, and the L888.4 caliber (an ETA-based automatic with a 72-hour reserve, COSC-certified) are the 2020 specification. The Spirit is the most-cited modern Longines and the watch a collector cites when they want a Tudor Black Bay competitor at the under-$2,500 price point.
narrative.collector_notes: The L888.4 is an ETA-based movement with a silicon balance spring. The 72-hour reserve and the COSC certification make it one of the strongest caliber specifications in the entry-luxury segment.
